mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the average forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain high rates and suppressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.25 million units signals strong housing demand and elevated consumer confidence, which drives forward equity returns as investors anticipate sustained consumption growth and corporate earnings expansion over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite HOUST > 1.25 million, or the average forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and deteriorating supply chain momentum, which reduces corporate profitability expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 102.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and residential investment (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and RSAFS are rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that delay rate cuts, increasing equity risk premiums and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS >= 5.0%, or the joint signal fails to outperform a simple average of individual signals (IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which triggers a hawkish Fed response and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE < 4.1% and PAYEMS > 158,000, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.0 and a concurrent drop in housing starts below 1.2 million signal a broad-based economic slowdown in both manufacturing and construction, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO < 102.0 and HOUST < 1.2 million, or the joint signal fails to show a significant negative average return (t-test p > 0.05).
